text: {"lessons":["My account is still above its Period 1 value, but the decline from its Period 7 peak shows that gains can reverse; I should plan for drawdowns rather than judge risk only by the long-run result.","Not trading has avoided impulsive reactions, but inactivity is not automatically prudent; I should periodically check whether the portfolio’s concentration and risk still suit me.","I should base buy and sell decisions on each stock’s prospects, valuation and role in the portfolio—not on its average cost or a desire to avoid realizing a loss."]}
